description: Utility functions and classes for subtitle synchronization, including format detection, parsing, serialization, sync checking, and applying corrections, specifically for SRT and VTT formats.

classes.name: SubtitleFormatError
classes.description: Custom exception class used for subtitle format errors.

methods.name: str detect_subtitle_format(file_path: str)
methods.description: Detects subtitle format ('srt' or 'vtt') based on file extension or file signature, raises SubtitleFormatError for unsupported formats.

methods.name: parse_srt(file_content: str)
methods.description: Parses SRT subtitle content into a list of tuples with start, end times in seconds, and subtitle text.

methods.name: float _srt_time_to_seconds(timestr: str)
methods.description: Converts SRT time string to total seconds.

methods.name: str _seconds_to_srt_time(seconds: float)
methods.description: Converts seconds to SRT time string format.

methods.name: serialize_srt(entries)
methods.description: Serializes a list of (start, end, text) tuples back into SRT subtitle content.

methods.name: check_subtitle_sync(video_path: str, subtitle_path: str)
methods.description: Performs a naive synchronization check by examining the first subtitle start time and suggests offset correction.

methods.name: apply_sync_correction(subtitle_path: str, offset_sec: float, output_path: str)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings by a given offset and writes the corrected subtitles to a new file.

ctags.name: apply_sync_correction
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_sync_correction(subtitle_path: str, offset_sec: float, output_path: str):$/
